reason: A TypeScript diagnostics plugin that automatically runs local tsc checks after relevant code edits and exposes structured errors through the code_check tool.

summaries.zh: 在代码编辑后自动运行本地 TypeScript 类型检查，并通过 code_check 工具返回结构化诊断信息。
summaries.en: Automatically runs local TypeScript type checks after code edits and provides structured diagnostics through the code_check tool.

capabilities: Monitors observed file changes in the workspace
Runs the local TypeScript compiler with --noEmit
Provides cached and on-demand code_check reports with file, location, severity, and error code details
